steps.code:
# Re-establish login and fetch following artists to get the most followed
# First, get the Spotify password from supervisor
passwords = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
spotify_pass = [p['password'] for p in passwords if p['account_name'] == 'spotify'][0]

# Login to Spotify
login_resp = apis.spotify.login(username='va-blac@gmail.com', password=spotify_pass)
access_token = login_resp['access_token']

# Fetch following artists (page_limit=20 to get all)
following = apis.spotify.show_following_artists(access_token=access_token, page_limit=20)
artists = following if isinstance(following, list) else following.get('artists', following)

# Find the artist with the highest follower_count
most_followed = max(artists, key=lambda a: a['follower_count'])
print(most_followed['name'])
